use_when: at the top of every page on the reader website.
at the bottom of every screen in the mobile app, as a tab bar.
Set the current page’s item to the Active state.

dont_use_when.when: for actions such as Reserve or Pay.
Do not show more than 5 items.

best_practice: Keep the same items in the same order on every page.
Use one-word labels, such as Home, Date or Shelf.
Show only one Active item at a time.

variant_intent.platform=Website: Figma: at the top of every page on the reader website. Code: Logo on the left, navigation on the right.
variant_intent.platform=Mobile: Figma: at the bottom of every screen in the mobile app, as a tab bar. Code: no Logo; navigation fills the bar.

placement: At the top of every page on the reader website.
At the bottom of every screen in the mobile app, as a tab bar.

a11y.fact: Navigation sits in a <nav> landmark, named "Main" by default.
The Active item is marked aria-current="page".
Each item is an <a> link with a visible label.
